name: Lantern Beam
text:
Requirements Your lantern light is shining

---
Effect Your lenses focus your light into a searing beam. You deal (max(5,ceil(@actor.level/2))d4) fire damage to all creatures in a 30-foot line, with a basic Reflex save saving throw against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Your lantern light then extinguishes, and you can't use this ability or use your lantern light again for 1d4 rounds. At 11th level and every two levels thereafter, the damage increases by 1d4.
